releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.6 (4-Engine Instant TikTok Link Resolver & Full URL Support)
releaseNotes:
• 4-Engine Instant TikTok Resolver: Concurrently races TikVideo, SaveTik, TikWM, and Direct TikTok Mobile/Desktop extractors + oEmbed metadata so links resolve reliably in under 1 second
• Broad TikTok Link Recognition: Supports vt.tiktok.com, vm.tiktok.com, lite.tiktok.com, @/video/, /photo/, bare links without https://, and pasted share messages
• Fixed False 'Private or Unavailable' Errors: Eliminates premature error aborts when one mirror fails
• Orbiting Star Border & Electric Midnight UI: Smooth animated perimeter light + traveling star around the TikTok Link Box
• Original Production Keystore Preserved: Seamless self-update signed with verified CN=TikSave certificate
